Actor Nikita Rawal Kissed By Fan At Event

Actress Nikita Rawal was forcibly kissed by a fan at an award show. A video of the incident, showing the fan approaching Rawal and kissing her, has gone viral online. Rawal is known for her role in the film 'Garam Masala'. The incident occurred at an unspecified award function.
